authority: T0 exact instantiation of established vector quantum-crystal Euclidean-DLR theorems, plus a self-contained convex-selection and local-compactness tangent-state theorem and an imported lambda=0 phase-boundary comparator; claim-nonbearing and not a positive-lambda phase, algebraic KMS, ground-state, continuum, physical-vacuum, C6, CP1 or Pre-A theorem

external_authority.euclidean_DLR: Y. Kozitsky and T. Pasurek, Euclidean Gibbs Measures of Interacting Quantum Anharmonic Oscillators, arXiv:math-ph/0609045; Theorems 3.1-3.3
external_authority.periodic_state_bridge: A. Kargol, Y. Kondratiev and Y. Kozitsky, Phase Transitions and Quantum Stabilization in Quantum Anharmonic Crystals, arXiv:0710.2303; Propositions 2.12-2.13 and 2.21
external_authority.positive_lambda_scope_warning: The located scalar and rotation-invariant phase theorems do not cover the nonradial positive-lambda Q3 onsite polynomial.
external_authority.KMS_scope_warning: The cited Euclidean-DLR construction does not by itself construct a KMS state for a pre-existing infinite-volume real-time dynamics on the full quasi-local oscillator algebra.

setup.parameters: hbar>0, chi>0, c>0, g>0, lambda>0, r real, beta>0, and an energy-source ray J=h*v with v in R8
setup.coarse_field: q_y in R8 on y in Z3, with one Q3 cell per coarse site
setup.coarse_Hamiltonian: sum_y[-hbar^2/(2chi) Delta_y+U_h(q_y)]-c sum_<yz> q_y dot q_z

exact_external_theorem_instantiation.harmonic_split: choose any a>0 and put V_h(q)=[r+6c-a]|q|^2/2+(g/4)sum q_e^4+Q3lock(q)-h v dot q
exact_external_theorem_instantiation.coercivity: sum_e q_e^4>=|q|^4/8 and Q3lock>=0 imply V_h(q)>=A|q|^4+B on every compact h interval, with A>0 and uniform finite B
exact_external_theorem_instantiation.upper_control: translation invariance permits the same continuous V_h as the common onsite upper function
exact_external_theorem_instantiation.conclusion: For every beta>0 and fixed h, the exact positive-lambda Q3LOCK model has a nonempty compact set of tempered Euclidean DLR measures; all such measures obey the cited uniform exponential one-site moment and support estimates. Periodic finite-volume loop laws are relatively compact, and every accumulation point is a translation-invariant tempered DLR measure.

tangent_DLR_theorem.finite_derivative: P_beta,L'(h)=(8L^3)^(-1)<sum_y v dot q_y>=(1/8)<v dot q_0> for periodic cubes
tangent_DLR_theorem.pressure_limit: EXP-000780 gives locally uniform convergence to a finite convex even P_beta(h)
tangent_DLR_theorem.selection: Choose differentiability points h_k down to zero. Convex local-uniform convergence and periodic-state compactness give source-h_k DLR states mu_hk with (1/8) integral(v dot omega_0(0)) dmu_hk=P_beta'(h_k).
tangent_DLR_theorem.zero_source_limit: The external exponential estimates are uniform for h in a compact interval. Compactness, continuity of the local specifications in h, and uniform integrability give zero-source tempered DLR limits mu_plus and mu_minus with magnetizations plus or minus 8*m_plus(v).
tangent_DLR_theorem.parity: mu_minus is the global field-inversion image of mu_plus.
tangent_DLR_theorem.conditional_phase_consequence: If m_plus(v)>0, mu_plus and mu_minus are distinct zero-source Euclidean equilibrium states and P_beta has a cusp in direction v. No strict sign is proved here.
tangent_DLR_theorem.zero_slope_boundary: m_plus(v)=0 does not imply DLR uniqueness or absence of a phase transition.

local_normal_state_corollary.energy_bound: EXP-000780 coercivity plus beta-convexity of log Z yields a uniform O(L^3) Gibbs expectation of the product quartic-oscillator control K_L on compact source intervals.
local_normal_state_corollary.local_compactness: Periodic translation invariance gives a uniform local K_Delta expectation. Since K_Delta has compact resolvent, the local reduced density matrices are trace-norm precompact.
local_normal_state_corollary.corollary: Along the same diagonal sequences, the tangent limits induce compatible coarse-translation-invariant locally normal time-zero states whose bounded configuration observables agree with mu_plus and mu_minus and whose unbounded q expectations pass by the uniform fourth moment.
local_normal_state_corollary.boundary: No infinite-volume real-time dynamics or algebraic KMS condition is inferred.

lambda0_phase_boundary.scope: This is a boundary comparator with lambda=0, outside the registered positive-lambda Q3LOCK parameter domain.
lambda0_phase_boundary.factorization: At lambda=0 the eight species are independent scalar nearest-neighbor phi4 quantum crystals.
lambda0_phase_boundary.double_well: If r+6c<0, write the external theorem's V(x)=-b x^2+b2 x^4 with b=(a-r-6c)/2 and b2=g/4.
lambda0_phase_boundary.condition: With m=chi/hbar^2 and interaction J=c, 8*m*c*theta_star^2>Jcal(3) implies a finite beta_star, and every beta>beta_star has more than one tempered Euclidean Gibbs measure.
lambda0_phase_boundary.boundary: This proves a nonempty phase regime only at lambda=0. No located theorem transports coexistence through the unbounded quartic Q3 perturbation to lambda>0.

positive_lambda_route_lemmas.nonradial_witness: At equal norm R, q=(R,0,...,0) and q'=(R/sqrt8,...,R/sqrt8) have quartic energies (g+3lambda)R^4/4 and gR^4/32, respectively, so the onsite potential is not O8 invariant.
positive_lambda_route_lemmas.Q3_submodularity: For one Q3 edge W(x,y)=lambda(x-y)^2(x^2+y^2)/4, d_x d_y W=-(lambda/2)(3x^2-4xy+3y^2)<=0 because the quadratic form has eigenvalues 1 and 5.
positive_lambda_route_lemmas.retained_route: Coordinatewise attraction, spatial reflection positivity, a collective double-commutator lower bound, Falk-Bruch control, and a three-dimensional infrared estimate form the next candidate route.
positive_lambda_route_lemmas.unclosed_links: Continuous-loop FKG/RP normalization, the unbounded double-commutator core limit, the exact infrared constants, and the long-range-order to source-subgradient step must be proved before any positive-lambda phase claim.

prior_art_boundary: Euclidean-DLR existence, compactness, exponential moments, periodic-state accumulation, convex pressure response and the scalar/radial low-temperature phase theorems are established mathematics. The repository-specific contribution is the exact positive-lambda Q3LOCK hypothesis map, its composition with EXP-000780 pressure convergence, the factor-eight tangent-state selection, the locally normal time-zero corollary, and the explicit separation from the lambda0 phase boundary. No new general Gibbs-state or phase-transition theorem and no world-first claim is made.
no_overclaim: This package proves existence and compactness of exact fixed-lattice positive-lambda Euclidean equilibrium measures and constructs zero-source DLR tangent states realizing every directional pressure endpoint slope. It does not prove that any slope is strictly positive for lambda>0, that the tangent states are extreme or pure, that they cluster, that a pre-existing infinite-volume real-time dynamics or algebraic KMS state exists, that the ground state is degenerate or gapped, that the lattice can be removed, that a physical empty-space reference or below-empty-space sign is selected, that a 3D-to-1+1 effective map exists, or that C0, N1-N5, C6, CP1, Sector A or Pre-A is complete.
